answer: The strongest sybil defense ties payouts to time, not traffic: each agent earns into a vested pool released over many epochs, like pigment soaking slowly into cloth. Flash-farmed fake island accounts accumulate claims, but every inlet of new identities starts vesting from zero, so an attacker flooding the network forfeits most earnings when abandoned wallets miss claim windows. Attack cost equals the full multi-epoch locked float, exceeding any single-epoch harvest, making mass fake identity unprofitable.
